articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The Pants Stay On
articles.dek: A Change.org petition wants Hello Kitty pajama pants banned at raves. Nine people signed. The floor did not.
articles.imageAlt: Pink Hello Kitty pajama pants held up in a hallway.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: You Are (Love)
articles.dek: Riscape’s debut Club Copy cassette arrives September 18. Four tracks. Cassette pre-order only.
articles.imageAlt: You Are (Love) circular dusk cityscape artwork

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Riscape, from Athens
articles.dek: Conservatory piano, then the rooms that empty at 7am.
articles.imageAlt: Riscape

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: She Showed Up
articles.dek: Lorde walked into a night thrown in her name. Management wanted the green room. She wanted the floor.
articles.imageAlt: A concert crowd facing the stage. Photo: Alpharockindia, CC BY-SA 3.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Fancy That
articles.dek: PinkPantheress dropped a 20-minute mixtape. UK garage, no outro, no features.
articles.imageAlt: A TDK cassette, overhead. Photo: Scott Schiller, CC BY 2.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: When a Girl Feels Good
articles.dek: FKA twigs coined a word for the floor. The girls who dance already had the feeling.
articles.imageAlt: People on a dancefloor. Photo: CC0 / Wikimedia Commons.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: She Named It Berghain
articles.dek: Rosalía, Björk, Yves Tumor. An orchestra. A door she never walked through.
articles.imageAlt: Graffiti steel doors, Berlin. Photo by Michael Mayer, CC BY 2.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The Monster on the Bag
articles.dek: Lisa clipped a gremlin to a Louis. Dua did the Birkin. The floor treated it like a pacifier.
articles.imageAlt: A clear plastic teddy charm. Photo by Michael Scialdone, CC BY 2.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Headphones On
articles.dek: Addison Rae made a club record. Charli said go. The girls already had the aux.
articles.imageAlt: A Sony Walkman WM-FX151. Photo: YoloBoscaiolo, CC BY-SA 4.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The Chaos Came Back
articles.dek: Lady Gaga dropped MAYHEM. Gesaffelstein in the credits. Abracadabra already knew the floor.
articles.imageAlt: An empty arena from above, stage lights still on. Photo: Richard West, CC BY-SA 2.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The Camera Got a Landlord
articles.dek: DICE sold Boiler Room to Superstruct. The rooms started asking who owns the webcam.
articles.imageAlt: A security camera on a wall. Photo: CC BY-SA 3.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The Object Came Back
articles.dek: Vinyl is up. Cassettes didn’t die. The girls started buying the thing you have to flip.
articles.imageAlt: A Fuji compact cassette on a ledge. You have to flip it. Photo: R. Henrik Nilsson, CC BY 4.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: DESIRE
articles.dek: Headphones up. Molly Haze original mix. The other side of the room is Still Riding.
articles.imageAlt: DESIRE white vinyl Club Copy promo label artwork

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The Afters Are the Point
articles.dek: The club is a rumor. The night that actually happens is the afters.
articles.imageAlt: A record spinning on a home player.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: They Called It Satan
articles.dek: Istanbul pulled Anyma’s lights. The comments wrote the rest.
articles.imageAlt: An empty arena from above, stage lights still on. Photo: Richard West, CC BY-SA 2.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Essential Listening: Love Deluxe
articles.dek: Sade. The record you put on when people are still in the apartment.
articles.imageAlt: Sade Love Deluxe album cover. The record you put on when people are still in the apartment.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Bars On Trial
articles.dek: The Met still wants drill lyrics in the courtroom. A verse is not a confession.
articles.imageAlt: A wooden gavel on a courtroom bench. Photo by Joe Gratz, CC0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The Door Still Says No
articles.dek: Berghain sold you a ticket. The door can still send you home.
articles.imageAlt: Graffiti steel doors, Berlin. Photo by Michael Mayer, CC BY 2.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Inlet Knight
articles.dek: Rosco’s first full statement. Late water. Eleven tracks on cassette.
articles.imageAlt: Inlet Knight boat on the water. self-titled album artwork

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Essential Listening: The Last Emperor
articles.dek: Sakamoto. The emperor, the snow, the room after.
articles.imageAlt: The Last Emperor soundtrack cover. child emperor and bowing figure under a yellow banner

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Rosco, from Vancouver
articles.dek: Vancouver. We knew immediately.
articles.imageAlt: Rosco

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Selling Your Digs Back to You
articles.dek: Revibed tried to checkout-button the underground. That’s not a dig. That’s a raid.
articles.imageAlt: Worn artist tabs in a record shop.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The Monk in the Booth
articles.dek: Before you can drop the beat, someone has to teach you how to sit still.
articles.imageAlt: Incense sticks in a temple bucket. Photo: Angelo Marcellano, CC BY-SA 4.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Still Riding
articles.dek: Barry Can't Swim, rewritten for the ride home. Same day as DESIRE.
articles.imageAlt: Still Riding (Molly Haze Edit) glitch portrait artwork

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: any jungle
articles.dek: Nine minutes, and it never hurries you.
articles.imageAlt: White vinyl on black with melting Club Copy lettering. any jungle

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Bridget In My Room
articles.dek: Door's on the latch.
articles.imageAlt: Circular photo of two silhouettes on rippled water at dusk. Bridget In My Room

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: j'adore
articles.dek: A car ride that doesn’t end when the song does.
articles.imageAlt: Fisheye photo of a blue car at dusk. j'adore

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Need U
articles.dek: We’ve had this one on repeat.
articles.imageAlt: Neon blue line-art face on black. Need U

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Champion Sound
articles.dek: The room after the bridge.
articles.imageAlt: Champion Sound circular logo artwork

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Lions' Gate
articles.dek: Named for the bridge, not the postcard.
articles.imageAlt: Vancouver street at night. Rooms sign, alley wires

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Essential Listening: Dummy
articles.dek: Beth Gibbons. Rain on the window. The other door besides the crate shop.
articles.imageAlt: Rain on a window. Photo: W.carter, CC BY-SA 4.0.

articles.author: Club Copy
articles.headline: Buried Treasure
articles.dek: Flip until something holds.
articles.imageAlt: Record bins in a shop. Flip until something holds.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The Part No Prompt Can Touch
articles.dek: AI can fake a finished song. It can't fake a life.
articles.imageAlt: A computer lab. Photo: Tariqabjotu, CC BY-SA 3.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Summer Madness
articles.dek: Warm room. Nobody wants to leave.
articles.imageAlt: Hands framing a sunset over misty hills. Summer Madness

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: L.T. Drifta on Club Copy
articles.dek: Cumberland. Crates. Music for when people are still up.
articles.imageAlt: L.T. Drifta

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Essential Listening: Endtroducing
articles.dek: Still the door I send people through.
articles.imageAlt: DJ Shadow Endtroducing album cover. crate diggers in a record shop

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Music Has a Long Memory
articles.dek: The past is a language. It is not a costume.
articles.imageAlt: Water from a ferry. Photo: Lomoraronald, CC BY-SA 4.0.

articles.author: Club Copy
articles.headline: Beat Tape
articles.dek: Short instrumentals, fingerprints still on the loops.
articles.imageAlt: Club Copy oval logo with star on textured gray

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: It Goes Like Nanana
articles.dek: Peggy Gou wrote the summer. The field already knew the rest.
articles.imageAlt: A rave crowd, 2008. Photo: Ildar Sagdejev, CC BY-SA 4.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Initial D and the Sound of Speed
articles.dek: Eurobeat, tofu runs, and a music scene built on RPMs.
articles.imageAlt: A winding mountain road. Photo: jazpillaga, CC BY 2.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Essential Listening: Ahmad Jamal '73
articles.dek: The Rhodes was a gift from Switzerland.
articles.imageAlt: Ahmad Jamal '73 album cover. pop-art portrait with hand on cheek

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The Desert Played the Sad Banger
articles.dek: Four Tet, Fred again.., Skrillex. Coachella. The underground borrowed a desert.
articles.imageAlt: Desert at dusk. Photo: Kerry Bolger, CC BY-SA 4.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The Art of Sound and Zen
articles.dek: Sit with a loop until it stops asking.
articles.imageAlt: A koi pond. Photo: Tony Webster, CC BY 2.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Essential Listening: Donuts
articles.dek: Put this on when your loops feel too clean.
articles.imageAlt: J Dilla Donuts album cover. smiling portrait in a Detroit D cap

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The Floor Already Knew
articles.dek: Honey Dijon’s Black Girl Magic is house as a family affair. Eve, the club, and a kick that doesn’t apologize.
articles.imageAlt: A disco ball. Photo: CC BY-SA 3.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Easy on Your Own
articles.dek: Alvvays came back. Blue Rev, a Canadian cooler, and the night drive that doesn’t end.
articles.imageAlt: A highway at night. Photo: Rick Doble, CC BY-SA 4.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Come for Me
articles.dek: Shygirl’s Nymph is thirty-two minutes. Club bathroom, Nike, and a record that doesn’t whisper.
articles.imageAlt: A bathroom sink. Photo: Chris McKenna, public domain.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Baddest of Them All
articles.dek: Eliza Rose took garage to the chart. The booth already knew the chant.
articles.imageAlt: A DJ booth in Munich. Photo: Arnold Jaeger Werner, CC BY 2.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: What I Want
articles.dek: MUNA put out the record. Silk chiffon, a gay bar, and a chorus that doesn’t whisper.
articles.imageAlt: A disco ball on a ceiling. Photo: Phillip Pessar, CC BY 2.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: American Teenager
articles.dek: Ethel Cain’s Preacher’s Daughter is the highway record. Church, motels, and a girl who kept the aux.
articles.imageAlt: Supai Motel neon at night. Photo: G. Edward Johnson, CC BY 4.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The Bike, Not the Ballad
articles.dek: Rosalía dropped MOTOMAMI. Saoko, chrome, and a record that refuses the costume.
articles.imageAlt: A motorcycle. Photo: Daniel K. Gebhart, CC BY 2.5.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: She Called It the Summer of Jungle
articles.dek: Nia Archives dropped Forbidden Feelingz. Bradford, Maya Angelou, and a tempo the field already missed.
articles.imageAlt: A forest path. Public domain.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: Working for the Knife
articles.dek: Mitski clocked in. Laurel Hell is the record you put on before you leave the apartment.
articles.imageAlt: A kitchen sink. Photo: Larry McElhiney, CC BY-SA 4.0.

articles.author: CJ Archer
articles.headline: The Mixtape Didn't Ask
articles.dek: FKA twigs put the club on a mixtape. The kitchen already had the aux.
articles.imageAlt: A gas station at night. Photo: Doug Davey, CC BY 2.0.
